svg.text: Save files and restart the desk
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 · protected backup storage and IIS Manager
While the pool is stopped, back up C:\Sites\PracticeHelpdesk, PHP configuration, IIS
site/pool/bindings, osTicket version, and any external attachment storage or plugins. ost-
config.php contains database secrets; protect it.
If an attachments plugin stores files outside the database, include that exact location. Keep
certificate private-key backups only in protected storage with a separate recovery process.
Restart the pool, return the desk Online, and submit a small test ticket. Copy backups to
protected storage outside APP01; a backup only on the VM can be lost with it.
Check: The desk works again and the recovery package includes database, files, configuration
